sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 6435 ± 30 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

literature_notes: All C-terminal tags (V5 in PMC3296735; YFP/eYFP/SYFP2 in PMC4156404/PMC7438548; Flag in PMC10842860) are intracellular (IC4: 396–466) and are excluded as extracellular sites. PMC10576055 (Flag + HA by site-directed mutagenesis) does not state the insertion position and cannot be pinned to a residue. PMC12771327 (HiBiT extracellular detection) does not state the tag position explicitly. No ledger evidence supports any internal extracellular loop (ECL1 192–218, ECL2 281–293, ECL3 362–368) insertion for GIPR.
